programs.description: Upon being raised by three undead beings, a human boy begins to question his identity. Subsequently, he sets off on a journey to learn more about the mysteries of his past.
Allen Walker joins the Black Order and trains intensively in order to become an exorcist and take down Millennium Earl. He must race against time before the villain uses his lethal weapon, the Akuma.
